data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series C AI & Software company founded by Vipul Ved Prakash, Ce Zhang, Chris Ré, Tri Dao, and Percy Liang, having raised $530M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-stage, same-sector comparables: Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), supplemented by a broader universe of eight private-sector and one public comparable (Palantir).

Stage-progression methodology was not applied due to data integrity concerns—the reported $8.3B last post-money valuation implies a step-up to $14.1B, which exceeds 20x total capital raised and suggests a potential data misparse. Peer-median triangulation was the applicable method, yielding a median valuation of $14.0B across the three same-stage peers, with a range spanning $10.0B to $39.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $11.9B (low) to $16.1B (high), centered on $14.0B. The wide dispersion within the comp set—driven primarily by Figure AI's $39.0B valuation relative to Crusoe Energy's $10.0B—reflects material uncertainty in frontier-AI valuations at Series C. Key uncertainties include downstream capital intensity, pathway to revenue, and competitive differentiation within a rapidly evolving sector.
